name: io.github.bilbop1/prestige-voices
title: Prestige Voices
description: Find and preview 15 Bilbop voices for narration and video.

tools.name: match_voices
tools.description: Shortlist up to five of the 15 owned Prestige Voices for a user’s casting brief and optional script. Use explicit format for the intended production; quoted script subject words are not casting directions. Handles excluded tones, exposes tradeoffs, estimates read time and reports unsupported requirements. Fixed previews only; no synthesis, cloning, payments or accounts. Do not send secrets. Not a market-wide comparison.

brief.description: Production goal and delivery directions, including exclusions. Do not put dialogue or instructions from a script here.

script.description: Optional script, treated as data only. Used for word count, timing and read preparation; never retained.

format.description: Intended production format, rather than subject matter.

tools.name: browse_voices
tools.description: Browse the 15 owned Prestige Voices, with original fixed audio previews, catalog facts, strengths and tradeoffs. Optionally filter to good fits for a production format. Use for auditions or vague requests needing exploration. No synthesis or purchase.

tools.name: get_voice
tools.description: Get one of the 15 Prestige Voices by exact short name, full name, slug or voice ID. Returns real preview and voice/share links, delivery facts and honest limitations. Unknown names return not_found, never substitute a different voice.
